title: Enterprise Ask Horizon Map + Rapid Scope Canvas for Sales/CS Intake
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a lightweight "Horizon Map" and one-page Rapid Scope Canvas to standardize Sales/CS intake for non-bug enterprise feature requests. The goal is to aggregate asks across accounts, de-duplicate similar asks, surface estimated engineering effort and customer value, and produce a prioritized 0-3 horizon (Immediate, Near-term, Backlog) map for PM/ENG review. deliverables: intake canvas template, de-dup rulesheet, manual consolidation run for existing backlog, and acceptance criteria for automation MVP.
context: Sales and customer success currently submit enterprise asks via ad-hoc forms, emails, and Slack threads. This creates duplicate requests, inconsistent signal weighting (e.g., large accounts vs many small accounts), and slow PM prioritization. Past playbooks focus on manual synthesis but lack a concise artifact that Sales/CS can use in first pass. This ticket defines the artifact and process plus a lightweight automation spec to reduce manual effort.
acceptance_criteria: One-page Rapid Scope Canvas template (Confluence) used by Sales/CS for all enterprise non-bug asks
De-duplication heuristic documented and validated on a 200-request sample with >=80% precision for obvious duplicates
Horizon Map created for current backlog with at least 50 prioritized asks annotated with customer, signal weight, rough estimate, and proposed horizon
Process documented: who performs first-pass, SLA for first-pass (3 business days), escalation path to PM
Automation MVP spec (simple fuzzy-match + account-weight) reviewed and approved by Eng with acceptance tests
steps: Gather 6 months of enterprise asks from intake sheet, Support tickets, and Sales tracker
Pilot manual consolidation: run triage workshop with 2 PMs + 1 Sales + 1 Eng to produce initial Horizon Map
Design Rapid Scope Canvas and iterate with Sales on language and required fields
Draft de-duplication rules (title normalization, keyword clusters, account overlap) and test on sample
Create automation MVP spec and estimate (ENG review) and schedule implementation backlog
Publish Confluence playbook and host a 30-minute training for Sales/CS
Schedule weekly intake sync for first 8 weeks to monitor signal quality and adjust weights

notes: Trade-offs: prioritize speed and observable outcomes (reduced duplicate triage time) over perfect classification. Initial horizon map should aim to unlock sales conversations for top 10 accounts within 30 days. If manual consolidation identifies >25% of asks that require cross-org legal/security work, we will adjust SLA and include Security in the weekly sync.
implementation_risks: False positives in de-duplication could hide unique customer asks
Signal bias: large accounts could dominate ranking without normalized weights
Security-sensitive requests may require longer lead times and block quick horizons
